entries.body: Write the requested short haiku. Do not invoke another skill.
entries.description: Use when asked to compose a haiku poem, especially about nature or seasons. Do not use for explanations of haiku.
entries.name: haiku-poem

entries.body: Write exactly two rhyming lines. Do not invoke another skill.
entries.description: Use when asked to write exactly two rhyming lines, a rhyming couplet. Do not use for haiku or poetry explanations.
entries.name: rhyming-couplet

entries.body: Calculate and state the requested measurement conversion. Do not invoke another skill.
entries.description: Use when asked to convert a numeric quantity between measurement units such as meters and feet or Celsius and Fahrenheit. Do not use for trivia or arithmetic without units.
entries.name: unit-conversion

entries.body: Return the given calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Do not invoke another skill.
entries.description: Use when asked to reformat a specific calendar date into ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD. Do not use for explanations of date standards.
entries.name: date-format
